# Bonfire/JellyProfiles

> A third-party plugin that adds profiles to Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.0. One account holds several people, each with their own watch history, library access and parental controls. It is not made by or part of Jellyfin. Free and MIT licensed. The current stable version is 1.7.0 (November 2026).

## Facts that are easy to get wrong

- Each profile is a real Jellyfin user, hidden from sign-in screens and linked to a main account. It has its own watch history, favourites and settings.
- Up to 20 profiles per account. The default limit is five; administrators can change it for the server or for one account.
- Library access, rating limits and tag filters are set on the profile's Jellyfin account, so the server enforces them in every app, including apps that can't show the switcher. A profile never gets more access than its main account.
- Rating limits use the ratings of the server's preferred metadata country, not only US ratings.
- PINs are checked on the server. A PIN can be skipped on the home network. Device limits are not a security boundary: an app can send any device ID.
- Profiles are created and edited from the switcher in a supported app, not from the admin dashboard.
- Install from the plugin repository `https://ahouseofbards.github.io/Bonfire-JellyProfiles/manifest.json`, then restart Jellyfin. On Docker, restart the container; the dashboard's Restart button often isn't enough. One build works on both 10.11 and 12.0.
- Bonfire doesn't edit Jellyfin's `index.html` and doesn't need any other plugin. No script tag in `index.html` is normal.
- Themes: nine looks for Bonfire's own screens (Bonfire, Crimson, Starlight, Harbor, Nightfall, Glass, and the seasonal Harvest, Snowfall and Bloom). Each profile can have its own, set from Settings → Theme on the main account. The administrator picks the default and can turn choosing off. The rest of Jellyfin keeps its own theme.
- Shared Bonfires: two accounts can link with a 6-character code so both households appear on one switcher.
- Languages: English, French, Polish and Turkish, picked from the browser's language. The admin page is English only.
- Administrators can set an emergency code that turns the profile screen off until Jellyfin restarts.
- Full switcher: Jellyfin Web, Jellyfin for Android, Jellyfin Media Player, LG webOS 4.5 and later, and Samsung Tizen (after a one-time setup).
- Profile sign-in on the app's own screen: Jellyfin for Android TV (confirmed), Roku, Swiftfin, Findroid and Wholphin (not yet confirmed). Turn it on under Dashboard → Bonfire → TVs & Apps, and type the profile's PIN as the password.
- Apps with only a username and password box (Streamyfin, Plezy, Tsukimi) work by typing a profile's name and PIN, once the main account has signed in on that app. This needs "Let profiles be opened with their PIN on any app" under TVs & Apps.
- Not supported: Infuse (no Jellyfin user list). Moonfin doesn't show profiles in its user list, but typing the full account name and PIN works. The official Jellyfin apps do not add plugin support, so Bonfire can't add a switcher to them.
